_note: New machine: run  python scripts/setup_workspace.py D:/ClipKit  (or pick the workspace in ClipKit Settings); it creates config.json with these paths. Scripts read config.json; never hard-code paths in a skill.
_models_dir_note: speech model (about 3 GB); empty = the default cache on C:, Settings sets it to <workspace>/models
_card_font_note: optional: any installed font, only used for quick preview renders; editors pick their own fonts in CapCut
_speech_language_note: language spoken in the clips: a Whisper code (th, en, ja, ...) or auto = detected per file; Thai-only clean-up runs only for th
_bot_api_url_note: optional local helper (MoonRacle dashboard/bot, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8765) that may embed these pages and restart a hung server; empty = off
_supabase_note: team hub. The anon key is public by design (RLS guards every table); the database password and service key never go in this file
_google_drive_note: optional: OAuth client (Google Cloud, type Desktop app, Drive API on) for the Team page's Share Drive link button; set it on the Team page
_auto_bug_report_note: legacy setting; automatic reports are disabled. Report a problem opens GitHub for manual review and submission
_autosave_note: ClipKit - Autosave: every save of a CapCut project is kept (clipkit_history/) and its changes logged on this machine only; python scripts/autosave_profile.py turns them into your editing style
